blocks.heading: Live Notices and Counts
rows: Learner who reads 30 live notices and counts skills
Best evidence
You see what employers ask for today, in your market.
Learner who follows a generic top-ten list
Weak evidence
The list may be old, global or promotional.
Learner who buys a course because a seller says it is in demand
Risky
The seller profits from your choice.
Learner who asks three working people what they would learn again
Strong evidence
People in the role know what is a must.

blocks.heading: Common Mix-Ups to Avoid
rows: Reading only one job site
Different sites show different employers.
Use at least three sources.
Counting keywords without reading
A skill may be listed in passing.
Mark must-have or bonus.
Ignoring location and level
Notices for senior roles list different skills.
Filter for your level and city.
